title: Bank Policies Preamble
author: Central Bank Authority
pages: The bank policies state how a bank should be run and handle various situations that the bank might encounter. Following these policies are vital for the survival of your bank.
Following these policies is mandatory, so we programmed them into every bank processor. The bank processor responds to various situations automatically for the safety of the bank.

Below are some major principles:
Do not trust any governors or governor candidates.
Build emerald golems and emerald skirmishers to protect the bank and the nearby village.

Build a reserve of supplies, then hoard emeralds to build more defenders.
You are supreme in your village, not the Muknek.
Do not let anyone through the iron door.
Always remember that you are the frontline against the dangers of the day and the night. Without the banks, everyone will perish.
The world rests on your shoulders and the Bank Policies.
